description: Source code for managing split index structures in a Git implementation, including functions for reading, writing, merging, and manipulating index entries and bitmaps.

methods.name: init_split_index
methods.description: Initializes the split_index structure within an index_state if not already initialized.

methods.name: read_link_extension
methods.description: Reads a link extension from data into the split index, including bitmaps.

methods.name: write_link_extension
methods.description: Serializes the split index's base_oid and bitmaps into a strbuf.

methods.name: mark_base_index_entries
methods.description: Marks entries in the base index with their position starting from 1.

methods.name: move_cache_to_base_index
methods.description: Transfers cache entries from the current index to its base index, handling memory pools.

methods.name: mark_entry_for_delete
methods.description: Marks a cache entry at a given position for deletion.

methods.name: replace_entry
methods.description: Replaces a cache entry at a given position with a saved cache entry.

methods.name: merge_base_index
methods.description: Merges the base index into the current index, handling deletions and replacements.

methods.name: compare_ce_content
methods.description: Compares the content of two cache entries, ignoring name and hashmap.

methods.name: prepare_to_write_split_index
methods.description: Prepares the index for writing by creating bitmaps and entries for split index operations.

methods.name: finish_writing_split_index
methods.description: Restores the index cache after writing a split index.

methods.name: discard_split_index
methods.description: Discards the split index and releases associated resources.

methods.name: save_or_free_index_entry
methods.description: Marks an index entry for removal if it belongs to the base split index, otherwise discards it.

methods.name: replace_index_entry_in_base
methods.description: Replaces a cache entry in the base index with a new entry.

methods.name: add_split_index
methods.description: Initializes a split index if not present and marks cache as ordered.

methods.name: remove_split_index
methods.description: Removes the split index from the index state, handling memory pools and resources.
